decisions.why: All examples are needlefree connectors and extension sets used in closed-system drug transfer for chemo preparation/delivery, procedure consumables.
Covers, check valves, Taxol filter, spike are all components of the closed-system drug transfer device range, procedure consumables.
Explicitly named Closed System Antineoplastic Drug Preparation Set plus male connector/injection valve/vial adapter — chemo procedure consumables.
3-way stopcocks with needlefree injection valve extension sets, all part of the same closed-system drug transfer range.
Coverall, face visor, gown, surgery mask are general PPE, not oncology-specific device consumables.
Vial adapters (positive/neutral/negative pressure) for the closed-system drug transfer range, procedure consumables.
Bag spikes with needlefree injection valve, part of the same closed-system drug transfer range.
Single product Disinfection Cap is an accessory for the closed-system connector range, procedure consumable.
